card.name: Words right before a repeated or linked noun
card.fires_on: Small words (who, his, own, a, the) and partway-through drug names that come just before a noun already tied to an earlier item in the sentence. Often the next word links two things, such as a defect in a ring gear or a drug combined with another drug.

modes.label: Possessive or linking word
modes.description: A pronoun or article that points back to a subject just mentioned, ahead of the noun it modifies.
modes.example: In despair at losing her, Alvaro plunges to<< his>> death down a deep ravine.

modes.label: Inside paired drug names
modes.description: Partway through a drug name that is being combined or mixed with another drug.
